delegation_format: aps:authority-delegation:v1 (agent-passport-system 8.0.1, npm integrity sha512-g9/AlzqX+L/fKzdsFQICGj59rYnXgeFxZcnmwD8WFNOK8aPSxT8FZEQe/PzGpnpG31xTLeLuMyrInX2B/Id5oA==). Each file is the complete signed chain, a JSON array root to leaf; delegation_id is the leaf's. Scope: aps-hierarchical-v1 grants in ot-scope/v1, one exact grant ot:<building_id>:<asset>:<parameter>:<operation> per tuple, no wildcards. Validity: authority.time, not_before inclusive, not_after exclusive, UTC milliseconds.
scope: The five cases of issue #27 as APS authority-delegation chains on the simulated building. Synthetic; TEST-ONLY keys derived from public labels (mint/mint.mjs); no physical control.

cases.construction: owner grants operator ZONE-01 and ZONE-02; operator grants agent ZONE-01 until 18:00; call ZONE-01 at 07:00, 20.5 degC
operator holds ZONE-01 and ZONE-02 but grants the agent ZONE-01 and ZONE-03 (signed directly; the SDK issuer refuses to widen)
the agent's grant for ZONE-01 ends at 06:00 (not_after, exclusive); the decision time is 07:00
a valid, narrowed chain grants the agent ZONE-02 only; the call is on ZONE-01
valid chain granting ZONE-01; the value 22.5 is outside the work order's 19.0..21.0, which the delegation does not carry
